title: Harness Manifest
description: The source of truth of an agent harness. Declares the variable parts of a harness (team, scopes, pipeline); the fixed parts (security model, gates, approval, slices) live in the harness-runtime skill and never change.

description.description: One-line summary of what this harness does.

skillDescription.description: Optional keyword-rich description for the orchestrator skill's frontmatter (triggers skill auto-loading). Defaults to 'description'.

standardVersion.description: Harness Factory standard version this manifest conforms to.

name.description: Slash command name WITHOUT the leading slash, e.g. 'ddd-plan' (opencode convention). Templates render the '/<name>' display form.

description.description: Description shown by the agent for this command.

agent.description: Name of the orchestrator agent. Defaults to <harness.name>-orchestrator.

template.description: Prompt template. '$ARGUMENTS' is replaced with the command arguments.

argument.description: Name of the scope CLI argument (the bounded context / target), e.g. 'scope'.

artifactRoot.description: Directory template for per-scope artifacts. '<scope>' is replaced at runtime. e.g. 'docs/architecture/<scope>'.

artifactBase.description: Base artifacts tree (parent of artifactRoot) that experts may write under. e.g. 'docs/architecture'.

name.description: Agent id of the orchestrator, e.g. 'ddd-orchestrator'.

cleanWorkingTree.description: Require a clean git status before starting.

pipeline.description: Ordered phases of the harness. Strictly sequential — no parallel phases.

deliverable.description: Path template of the consolidated plan, e.g. 'docs/architecture/<scope>/refactor-plan.md'.

approvalRequired.description: Present the plan and STOP for explicit approval before execution.

mode.description: 'slices': apply behavior-preserving slices one at a time with gates per slice. 'single': one shot.

sliceRule.description: Free-text rule defining what a valid slice is (e.g. one bounded context per slice, no contract changes).

source.description: Where the skill comes from, e.g. 'wondelai/skills' (same shape as skills-lock.json).

skillPath.description: Path to the SKILL.md inside the source, e.g. 'domain-driven-design/SKILL.md'.

id.description: Unique expert id, used as the agent name, e.g. 'expert-strategic'.

role.description: Role template id from templates/roles/, e.g. 'analysis-expert'.

roleLabel.description: Human label for the role, e.g. 'Strategic Design'.

description.description: Mission statement used as the agent description. Overrides the generic 'roleLabel + skills' default.

skills.description: Skills this expert loads, e.g. ['prisma-client-api', 'prisma-database-setup']. Renders one skill load per entry.

skillSource.description: Where the skill is installed from (used by 'npx skills add').

deliverable.description: Path template of the artifact this expert writes, e.g. 'docs/architecture/<scope>/context-map.md'.

anyOf.description: Path template of a prior artifact, e.g. 'docs/architecture/<scope>/context-map.md'.

ref.description: Reference to another expert's deliverable by id, e.g. 'expert-strategic.deliverable'.

input.description: Inputs this expert consumes (prior artifacts or repo paths).

readPaths.description: Source paths this expert may read (permission allowlist).

task.description: The domain task sentence, e.g. 'identify core/supporting/generic subdomains, bounded contexts and context mapping for the existing API'.

summary.description: What the expert returns to the orchestrator, e.g. 'score, violations, and the artifact path written'.

trigger.description: Keywords the selector matches against the intent (routing metadata).

prompt.description: Extra instruction appended to the role template prompt.

permission.description: Per-expert permission overrides on top of the role template defaults.

id.description: Agent id of the executor, e.g. 'executor'.

role.description: Role template id from templates/roles/, e.g. 'executor'.

description.description: Mission statement used as the executor agent description.

hardConstraints.description: Extra per-executor HARD CONSTRAINTS rendered verbatim, e.g. ['no edits to app.module.ts unless the blueprint says so'].

writePaths.description: Source paths this executor may WRITE (permission allowlist), e.g. ['apps/api/**'].

bash.description: Allowed bash command patterns for the executor.

gates.description: Per-slice verification gates the executor runs before committing.

messageTemplate.description: Commit message template; '<slice>' is replaced with the slice name.

dir.description: Working directory for the gates, relative to repo root.

expect.description: 'no-new-errors': pass if no NEW errors over the baseline count.

notes.description: Optional per-gate note rendered into the executor prompt, e.g. '>= baseline count, all green, boot guard (app.module.spec.ts) green'.

blocking.description: A failed blocking gate trips the tripwire (hard stop).

description.description: Free-text describing what this phase delivers, e.g. '(aggregates, invariants, ubiquitous language, scoring)'.

path.description: Directory or deliverable path (for type=mkdir / synthesize).

validation.description: Artifact gate checked after the phase (default for delegate: artifact exists and is non-trivial).

stopOnFail.description: STOP and report instead of proceeding if the phase fails.
